signal: Casepoint announced a strategic partnership with Proofpoint and expanded its unified AI-powered eDiscovery and compliance platform

email.body1:
Nick, saw Casepoint launched its Proofpoint partnership and expanded the unified AI platform across eDiscovery and compliance.

Launches like that usually open more in-market corporate accounts than BD can actually touch, and that is where good-fit deals quietly stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Casepoint off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: a quick teardown of your outbound
email.body2:
Nick, quick follow-up for Casepoint.

Selling into corporate legal and compliance usually means long buying groups and slow follow-up, and most BD reps lose hours to research and CRM instead of conversations. Tightening that motion is often where the easy lift hides.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50 to 70 percent, and I will tailor it to your corporate targets.
email.body3:
Nick, last bit of proof for Casepoint.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Casepoint's reply rate likely compares to other legal-tech firms selling into corporate. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Nick, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling corporate BD pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after a platform push there is plenty competing for your attention.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a corporate legal-tech motion? I will tailor it to Casepoint either way.
